title: A Study of Efficacy of Zinc Oxide Nanoparticles Coated Socks in Prevention of Unpleasant Foot Odor
brief_summary: This study aimed to study the efficacy of zinc oxide nanoparticles coated socks in prevention of unpleasant foot odor
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* First-year naval rating cadets, who had no pedal malodor

Exclusion Criteria:

* The cadets who previously received any topical treatment including topical antibiotic, antiperspirant or aluminum chloride within 6 months prior to the study.
